title: Multi-Tower Ajax Proposal Grows Denser as Development Nears
summary: The redevelopment of a former industrial site on Bayly Street in Ajax is getting closer as a revised Site Plan Approval submission is being reviewed by the planning department in the town east of Toronto. Initially proposed in 2022 by 95 Developments, a company that has been specializing in condominium projects on the east side of Toronto, especially in Scarborough, this Ajax site on the west side of its expanding downtown area was targeted for four slab-style buildings rising from mid-rise podiums, three to 20 storeys and one to 13 storeys, in an area that has long been home to low-rise commercial/industrial buildings.
